description: Student interested in game design and AI. This team's goal is to create an interactive narrative about the long forgotten space equipment of NASA. Join if you connect with this goal!
summary: I developed a web-based game where a user can choose to immerse themselves into the story of nine abandoned spacecrafts. It addresses the challenge of helping younger individuals understand how abandoned technology has taught us more about space by putting them in the story of the spacecraft. It is interactive so they are able to control when the story continues and are engaged as a younger audience. Another twist in this game is that it combines the story of a spacecraft with an aspect which can affect one’s mental health. This allows the audience to see themselves in the story of the spacecraft and better understand the plot. This is important because humanity has explored the far depths of space and the ocean, but the importance of mental health has been increased only recently. With this development, users will be able to explore an aspect that affects them, learn how it affects them, learn about a real spacecraft, and increase their awareness of their own mental health. Overall, this web-based application explores mental health themes through the lens of an abandoned spacecraft, teaching people about space technology while raising awareness about mental health.
details: My project allows users to play a game by clicking buttons and pressing specific keys. It has the benefits of allowing players to play an interactive game and choose which story they want to immerse themselves in. It also has easy user navigation which makes it appropriate for all ages to play. The intended impact of this project is to allow users to learn about abandoned space technology and explore aspects that can affect one’s mental health. This project used the coding languages of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. This project also used the software VS Code to develop the game. This project is creative because it also combines aspects that affect mental health with the story of a specific abandoned space technology, allowing users to see themselves in one of the many stories this project provides. Some factors that I considered was what would make a younger audience play this game and how I can make it interactive without having to change the entire story of each spacecraft. These factors shaped my project scope and plan, leading to an interactive experience about abandoned space equipment.
